identificationModule.briefTitle: Anti-Androgens and Cabazitaxel in Defining Complete Response in Prostatectomy (ACDC Trial)
identificationModule.officialTitle: Anti-Androgens and Cabazitaxel in Defining Complete Response in Prostatectomy (ACDC-RP Trial): A Randomized, Open-label, Multi-centre Phase-2 Study Evaluating the Pathological Complete Response (pCR) Rate Following Neoadjuvant Therapy in Participants With High-risk Prostate Carcinoma for Whom Radical Prostatectomy is Indicated

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study evaluates the use of chemotherapy with cabazitaxel in addition to abiraterone acetate, prednisone, and leuprolide in neoadjuvant setting prior to radical prostatectomy in patients with high-risk prostate carcinoma. Half of the participants will receive treatment with abiraterone acetate, prednisone, leuprolide, and cabazitaxel, while the other half will receive only abiraterone acetate, prednisone, and leuprolide.

armGroups.label: Abiraterone acetate + prednisone + leuprolide + cabazitaxel
armGroups.description: Participants randomized to this arm will receive abiraterone acetate (1000 mg/day), prednisone (5 mg twice daily), leuprolide (22.5 mg every 3 months), and cabazitaxel (20 mg/m2, with 6 mg pegfilgrastim administered 24 h following cabazitaxel) prior to radical prostatectomy.

armGroups.label: Abiraterone acetate + prednisone + leuprolide
armGroups.description: Participants randomized to this arm will receive abiraterone acetate (1000 mg/day) , prednisone (5 mg twice daily), and leuprolide (22.5 mg every 3 months) prior to radical prostatectomy.

interventions.name: Abiraterone acetate with prednisone
interventions.description: Abiraterone acetate will be administered orally as a tablet at 1000 mg/day with prednisone (5 mg oral tablet, twice daily) for 24 weeks.

interventions.name: Leuprolide
interventions.description: Leuprolide will be administered by subcutaneous injection at 22.5 mg dose every 12 weeks for 24 weeks.

interventions.name: Cabazitaxel with peg-filgrastim
interventions.description: Cabazitaxel will be administered in 6 cycles, with 20 mg/m2 per cycle and 3 weeks between cycles.

secondaryOutcomes.description: The effect of neoadjuvant leuprolide, and abiraterone acetate and prednisone with and without cabazitaxel on pre-operative PSA will be evaluated.
The effect of neoadjuvant leuprolide, abiraterone acetate, and prednisone with and without cabazitaxel on mean nadir PSA levels will be evaluated.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Percentage of participants achieving a PSA < 0.2 ng/mL
secondaryOutcomes.description: The percentage of participants achieving a PSA \< 0.2 ng/mL following treatment with neoadjuvant leuprolide, abiraterone acetate, and prednisone with and without cabazitaxel will be evaluated.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Percentage of participants achieving a 50 and 90% decrease in PSA levels
secondaryOutcomes.description: The percentage of participants achieving a 50 and 90% decrease in PSA levels following treatment with neoadjuvant leuprolide, abiraterone acetate, and prednisone with and without cabazitaxel will be evaluated.
The rate of positive surgical margins following treatment with neoadjuvant leuprolide, abiraterone acetate, and prednisone with and without cabazitaxel will be evaluated.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Rate of near-complete response (<5 mm tumour)
secondaryOutcomes.description: The rate of near-complete response (\<5 mm tumour) following treatment with neoadjuvant leuprolide, abiraterone acetate, and prednisone with and without cabazitaxel will be evaluated.
The rate of extracapsular extension following treatment with neoadjuvant leuprolide, abiraterone acetate, and prednisone with and without cabazitaxel will be evaluated.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Rate of positive seminal vesicle involvement
secondaryOutcomes.description: The rate of positive seminal vesicle involvement following treatment with neoadjuvant leuprolide, abiraterone acetate, and prednisone with and without cabazitaxel will be evaluated.
The rate of nodal involvement following treatment with neoadjuvant leuprolide, abiraterone acetate, and prednisone with and without cabazitaxel will be evaluated.
Tumour proliferation, indexed using Ki-67 immunohistochemistry, following treatment with neoadjuvant leuprolide, abiraterone acetate, and prednisone with and without cabazitaxel will be evaluated.
Androgen receptor expression will be evaluated using immunohistochemistry following treatment with neoadjuvant leuprolide, abiraterone acetate, and prednisone with and without cabazitaxel.
Incidence of adverse events will be evaluated for the duration of the study.
Severity of adverse events will be evaluated for the duration of the study.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Androgen levels (if optional biopsy tissue is available)
secondaryOutcomes.description: If the participants agrees to optional pre-treatment biopsy, androgen levels will be compared between the pre-treatment tissue samples and prostatectomy tissue.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Genomic alterations between pre- and post-treatment tissue
secondaryOutcomes.description: If the participants agrees to optional pre-treatment biopsy, genomic alterations between the pre-treatment tissue samples and prostatectomy tissue will be evaluated.
